verdict.rationale: The SDK harness runs on your own infrastructure. Hosting docs cover deploying it on Docker, Kubernetes and sandbox providers, including subprocess architecture, scaling and multi-tenant isolation. It bundles the Claude Code binary, and a SessionStore adapter lets transcripts live in your own backend. However, the agent is billed through Anthropic (the community billing-change reports show usage depends on Anthropic's plans), and nothing shows the model itself can be self-hosted, so only the orchestration layer is truly self-hostable. Missing for 10: self-hostable or offline model inference, evidence of running without Anthropic's service, independent hands-on self-hosting reports.
